candidate.answerReason: Changing to base 10 gives \(\log_5 10=1/(1-\log_{10}2)\approx1.431\). The closest choice is \(10/7\).

methods.label: Change to base 10
methods.explanation:
The supplied logarithms use base 10, so changing to that base lets us use the given information. First,
\[
\log_{10}5=\log_{10}\frac{10}{2}
=1-\log_{10}2\approx0.699.
\]
The change of base formula therefore gives
\[
\log_5 10=\frac{\log_{10}10}{\log_{10}5}
\approx\frac1{0.699}\approx1.431.
\]
To check that the rounding does not affect the choice, the given accuracy implies
\[
0.6985\leq\log_{10}5\leq0.6995.
\]
These denominators are positive, so taking reciprocals shows that
\[
1.429<\log_5 10<1.432.
\]
The choice \(10/7\approx1.4286\) differs from every number in this interval by less than \(0.004\). Its neighboring choices, \(9/7\approx1.2857\) and \(11/7\approx1.5714\), differ by more than \(0.13\); the remaining choices are farther away. Thus the best approximation is \(\boxed{10/7}\), choice C.
